operation.name: GetNonGBVMainExtended
operation.query:
SELECT distinct M.[NonGBVMainID] ,M.[Date] ,M.[SerialNumber] ,M.[StateID] ,M.[CountyID] ,M.[PayamID] ,M.[BomaID] ,M.[DateOfComplaint] ,M.[ReportingChannel] ,M.[ComplainantName] ,M.[SSSNPBeneficiary] ,M.[TypeOfGrievanceID] ,M.[TypeOfGrievanceDetailID] ,M.[TypeOfGrievanceOther] ,M.[Status] ,M.[StatusLastModificationDate] ,CASE WHEN (dateadd(DAY,9, [Date]) < getdate() and m.Status <> 5) then '1' else '0' END as Expired, s.StateName , c.CountieName , p.PayamName, b.BomaName, stat.StatusName, case when stat.StatusID=7 then 1 when stat.StatusID=1 then 2 when stat.StatusID=2 then 3 when stat.StatusId != 5 then 4 else 5 end as OrderById
FROM [NonGBVMain] as M left join NonGBVDetails as d on (d.NonGBVMainID = m.NonGBVMainID and d.Deleted = 0) inner join tm_States as S on s.intStateid = m.StateID inner join tm_Counties as c on c.intCountieid = m.CountyID inner join tm_Payams as P on p.intPayamid = m.PayamID inner join tm_Bomas as B on b.intBomasid = m.BomaID inner join LK_GBVStatus as Stat on (stat.StatusID = m.Status and stat.NonGBVStatus = 1) WHERE M.Deleted = 0
